coral-rose.$description: Coral Rose — Accent for heading text, hairline borders, and active-state markers — the single chromatic signal in an otherwise achromatic system

pure-white.$description: Pure White — Page canvas, card surfaces, and inverted backgrounds

cloud.$description: Cloud — Pill nav background, subtle surface elevation, and inset border shadows

bone.$description: Bone — Warm-toned secondary surface tint for alternating bands

char.$description: Char — Primary text, body copy, and most interface strokes

ink.$description: Ink — Heavier headings, body text, and prominent borders

black.$description: Black — Maximum-emphasis text, logo wordmark, and strong border lines

fog.$description: Fog — Muted helper text and disabled-state strokes

mist.$description: Mist — Lowest-emphasis borders and decorative dividers

apple-system.$description: System-font fallback for body text and rendering across platforms. Used wherever native OS fonts provide a reliable, performance-optimized default at body size.

geist.$description: Primary display and UI typeface. The 300 weight at micro sizes (8–10px) creates whisper-quiet labels; the negative letter-spacing (-0.056em at 8px, -0.037em at 10px) tightens small type into dense, confident blocks. 400 at 16–18px serves body and subheadings with -0.025em to -0.011em tracking.

wtqc-custom-display.$description: Reserved for prominent display headings (30px, 1.07 line-height, -0.033em tracking) and compact labels (12px, 1.33 line-height). The tight 1.07 line-height on the 30px size gives headings a condensed, editorial feel.
